returnWindowDays.description: How long after authorization the goods may arrive.

maxUnitsPerLine.description: The cap on an authorized quantity until order-management adds quantity to its lines.

vetoOutcome.description:
The disposition outcome. Only RESTOCK has a downstream effect
(`ReturnLineStaged`); the others are recorded for audit.

rules.description: The (grade, productClass) table; every grade needs a "*" default, which makes Decide total.

grade.description: The inspection grade of a return line.

productClass.description: The product classification this rule keys on, or "*" for the per-grade default.
